svg.title: Noctium project goals: the full native Midnight capability map
svg.desc: Research preview. Project goals cover full native ZKIR v3 (47 instruction variants and 15 native value types), a Lean contract language with checked proofs, ledger state and composition, private witnesses and guarded disclosure, Rust/C++/TypeScript/WASM/Kotlin/Swift SDKs, and reproducible proof-to-deployment assurance. Current evidence includes 38 scoped opcode names, historical private-claim Rust/C++ lifecycles and a 16-entrypoint token with 17 accepted localnet calls at recorded revisions. Latest source/native checks cover byte ledger values from zero through 1024 bytes and direct Native/Jubjub scalar decoding, preserving empty-operand assertions. Ordered transient field hashing also has scoped native/host checks, including empty vectors, legacy equivalence and cached-operand assertions. Typed ECDSA, Jubjub Schnorr, Ed25519 and Ethereum address helpers now have focused Source/native vector checks. Structured helper branches compile through shared guard lowering. Native structured entries now add typed scalar cell/map reads, membership and writes against the owning schema, with ordered effects and proof-bound read returns. Typed guarded witnesses now have scoped native checks for skipped callbacks, canonical inactive slots, continuation calls and private staging. A resumable native preparation API now exposes ledger reads before private inputs arrive and reuses the checked executor. Source witness/state coordination remains open. Full native coverage, signature assurance, composition, web/mobile SDKs and complete compiler preservation remain open. The capability panels show goals, not a claim of full delivered coverage. No Compact dependency.

RESEARCH PREVIEW
Prove contract behavior. Target the full native Midnight stack.
Lean 4 compiler and proofs · Direct native backend · No Compact dependency or scope ceiling
